records.preparation: Shake concentrate thoroughly and prepare the 1+4 working solution immediately before use.
records.capacityText: Use at least 250 ml working solution per film.
records.shelfLifeOpened: Concentrate: recommended up to 9 months after opening.

records.preparation: Dissolve the powder in demineralized water to prepare the stock solution; prepare diluted working solution just before use when a dilution is required.
Mix solution A and solution B with water; standard working dilution is 1+2+100.
records.capacityText: Up to 1000 cm2 film per litre of working solution: approximately 2 rolls of 135-36 or 2 rolls of 120.
records.shelfLifeUnopened: Solutions A and B: up to 10 years, even in half-filled bottles.
records.shelfLifeWorking: Working solution in open containers: about 1 hour without affecting development quality.
records.storageNotes: Keep solutions tightly closed and protected from light.

records.capacityText: 2x100 ml makes 10 litres working solution, capacity 40 films; 2x250 ml makes 25 litres, capacity 200 films.

records.preparation: Dilute developer and alkali 1+1+100 with demineralized water immediately before development.
records.capacityText: 2x100 ml makes 20 litres working solution, capacity 40 films; 2x250 ml makes 25 litres, capacity 100 films.
records.shelfLifeUnopened: Concentrate A: one year or longer; concentrate B: unlimited.

records.preparation: Standard working dilution is 1+1+100; use demineralized water and prepare working solution shortly before development.
records.capacityText: 2x100 ml makes 20 litres working solution, capacity 40 films.
records.shelfLifeUnopened: Concentrate A: 18 months or longer; concentrate B: unlimited.
records.shelfLifeWorking: Working solution should be used within approximately 10-15 minutes after mixing.

records.preparation: For most films prepare developer A + activator B + demineralized water at 2+1+50; consult the manufacturer chart for deviations.
records.capacityText: At 2+1+50, the supplied 250 ml A + 500 ml B develops 50 rolls of 135 or 120.
records.shelfLifeUnopened: Concentrate A: guaranteed minimum 2 years; concentrate B: unlimited.
records.shelfLifeWorking: Working solution remains usable for a few days, but manufacturer recommends preparing only what will be used immediately.

records.preparation: Dilute concentrate 1+9 with water to make the working solution.
records.reuseInstructions: Basic negative-processing directions use the developer once; replenishment instructions are available for large-volume processing.
records.capacityText: 1 litre concentrate makes 10 litres working solution, enough for at least 50 rolls of 35 mm 36-exposure film; replenished solution can process about 110 rolls.
records.sourceTitle: SPRINT STANDARD B&W Film Developer / How To Mix
